control.name: CONTROL — loosen the oversize comparison (a file of exactly the threshold is reported)

mutations.name: read a missing git as an EMPTY work tree (both scans silently pass having looked at nothing)
read a FAILED ls-files as an empty work tree (a non-repo root reports clean instead of could-not-check)
drop the declared fixture exclusion (issue #200 re-opens: the tool's own testdata fixture fails the gate)
widen the exclusion to any segment CONTAINING testdata (a real conflict under mytestdata/ goes unseen)
let the exclusion match a FILE named testdata, not only a directory component
stop printing the declared exclusion (the check hides the shape it cannot see)
read a grep ERROR as no-match (could-not-check collapses into clean)
drop -H from grep (a single-file batch's match names a line number instead of a file)
hand grep a path that is not a regular file (a mid-refactor deletion or a gitlink blocks the gate)
drop the junk-NAME half of the check (only size is left; a stray .orig rides in)
